Internal dashboard child runtime

Usage: gaze proxy _dashboard-child --bind-addr <BIND_ADDR> --ttl-secs <TTL_SECS> --max-events <MAX_EVENTS> --max-bytes <MAX_BYTES>

Options:
      --bind-addr <BIND_ADDR>    
      --ttl-secs <TTL_SECS>      
      --max-events <MAX_EVENTS>  
      --max-bytes <MAX_BYTES>    
  -h, --help                     Print help
